details.baseFeeSealComparison: For equal starting tier, successful Despair and failed ordinary upgrade pass the same oldStoredTier+1 to applyForgingPotentialCostFromShard; their later Forge outcomes and refunds can differ.
details.chaos: upgrades first, rerolls roll unless preserved, then invokes identity reroll helper
details.costOrder: New add charges tier=0 before adding; upgrade charges with incremented storedTier. Successful sealing charges with old storedTier+1. Full Forge postprocessing belongs to separate FP audit.
details.criticalEligibility: Current Forge audit confirms Chaos skips the critical entrance; ordinary/failed Despair paths are additionally gated by primary-affix shard stock. Full evidence in forge-fp-claims.json.
eligibility: FP>0; ordinary-craft item category; full Forge capability restrictions
CanForgeOnItem uses actual item base/subtype/class requirement
selected affix cannot already be sealed
new affix requires free compatible prefix/suffix capacity
details.newAffix: adds selected ID at storedTier=0; absent explicit roll uses RandomByte
details.tierStorage: displayTier=storedTier+1; existing storedTier>=4 is at ordinary craft maximum
details.upgrade: existing storedTier<4 increments once; ordinary upgrade without preserveRollWithinTier redraws roll byte

limitations: CanForgeOnItem has an already-present-affix compatibility-override list fallback; complete legacy-ID membership not decoded in this report.
claims.summary: 普通添加/升级受实际底材、角色等级、词缀与槽位资格约束，普通碎片升级止于T5。

details.failure: selected affix normally upgrades, may redraw roll and incurs its native cost/postprocessing; route then terminates under user policy.
details.hasExaltedMeaning: hasExaltedAffix scans all affixes for storedTier>=5; no sealed exclusion in this helper.
details.probabilitySaturation: getChanceToSealAffix itself does not clamp; Roll(q>=1) returns true and Roll(q<=0) returns false.
details.rarityMeaning: For valid ordinary items setRarityFromAffixes clamps listCount - regularSealed - primordialSealed - corruptedSealed to0..4.
details.routePolicy: If seal success is required, failed Bernoulli branch is an absorbing route-failure leaf after completing the native action.
details.success: SealAffix moves the selected object to list start, marks sealedType=1 and regular sealed slot, updates rarity, keeps tier and roll.

claims.summary: 必要封印一次尝试；成功保原阶封入普通封印槽，失败走普通升级路径。

details.costOrder: Non-affix FP cost is applied before tier shuffle.

examples.twoT7DifferentLowTiers: A=12; two successful arrangements; nominal goal chance2*(1-12^-10000)/11

details.idealIidModel: If A distinct tier arrangements are equally likely and current x is not successful, each other arrangement y has probability (1-A^-10000)/(A-1), and x has tail probability A^-10000.
mutations: Nonsealed affix IDs and roll bytes remain attached to their affix objects.
Stored tiers are collected, shuffled, written back, then the item is rebuilt and deserialized.
No Standard-only filter exists in the Havoc tier collector.

limitations: The equal-permutation formula is exact under an explicitly independent uniform permutation model, not a proof of exact seeded PRNG probabilities.
The 10000-attempt tail must be bounded or retained rather than silently deleted.
claims.summary: 浩劫只重分配未封印词缀的阶数，并拒绝原阶数序列。

candidateFilters: candidate ID absent from complete current affix list, including sealed IDs and own current ID
details.emptyCandidatePool: Helper leaves the item unchanged when candidate list is empty; consuming the rune is controlled by the outer action, not inferred here.
details.mutations: Writes new affixId only, then RebuildID/setValuesFromSerialisation; maintains storedTier and roll bytes through the identity change.
details.weight: Use first matching equipmentType override weighting, otherwise definition.weighting; if w<1, float32min(1,float32(2*w)); otherwise w unchanged.
details.weightedImplementation: GetRandomWeighted chooses stack variant for candidateCount<=128 and iterator variant above128.

limitations: Bit-level float32 cumulative weighted-selection boundary effects are not certified by normalized rational weights alone.
claims.summary: 混沌与救赎共用按当前完整状态加权的同侧普通候选池。

details.costOrder: Non-affix FP cost occurs before processing affixes.
details.jointDistribution: Expand each sequential reroll using its UPDATED whole-item ID exclusion set; candidate draws cannot be factored as independent simultaneous slot draws.
details.order: Iterates actual affix list index from0 upwards and reloads item.affixes each step; each identity reroll rebuilds/deserializes before the next index.
details.selectedAffixes: Every current nonsealed affix with storedTier+1>=6; helper does not require the source affix specialAffixType==0.
details.tierAndRoll: ID changes preserve stored tier and normalized roll byte.

limitations: Do not sort native affix order during canonicalization.
Order of ordinary affixes across full serialization roundtrip is cross-checked in the FP/serialization audit; this action report does not claim a UI can freely reorder them.
claims.summary: 救赎依实际列表索引逐条重抽全部未封印崇高词缀，不能锁定已有好T7。

details.nominalProbability: 1/N per eligible affix under ideal uniform index draws; permitted target set success mass = permittedEligibleCount/N.
details.routePolicy: After the native action and full costs, removal outside the predeclared permitted ID/slot set is absorbing failure; no rescue or reroll branch.

claims.summary: 剥离只在未封印Standard词缀池中随机选择，T7没有保护。

details.classMatch: req==31 OR specificity==0 OR (req==0 AND specificity&1!=0) OR ((req<<1)&specificity!=0), for legal class flags.
details.equipmentType: Use GetEquipmentTypeForBaseType(baseType); do not assume displayed text is a key.
details.ordinaryScope: Nonempty ordinary equipment base types0..24 excluding11 and24 (23 types); subgroup branch above is retained for completeness but not used by ordinary gloves.
details.typeMatch: definition.canRollOn contains actual equipmentType OR supports subtypeGroup.

claims.summary: 普通装备23类范围的底材/职业匹配与额外神像底材组已按原生helper还原。

details.primordial: Model primordial sealed slot separately from regular Despair sealed slot. Evolution is an extension operation, not silently added to core action search.
details.sealedType: ItemAffix.IsSealed is sealedType>0, not specialAffixType!=0; do not conflate them.
details.tierStorage: storedTier byte is displayTier-1; T8 stored7 still satisfies IsExalted, but legal primordial affix is excluded from operations by sealedType.

claims.summary: 封印状态与词缀特殊类别是独立维度；原初T8位于独立封印槽。

details.gridInterpretation: For hypothetical iid uniform23bit-grid U and 0<q<1, effective Roll mass=(floor(q*2^23)+1)/2^23; actual seeded correlations require RNG-state modeling.
details.nextInt: min + floor((max-min)*oldUint32/2^32) for legal min<=max; max excluded when min<max; equal bounds return min and still advance RNG.
details.randomByte: Returns high8 bits of oldUint32 and advances RNG.
details.roll: q<=0 false without a draw; q>=1 true without a draw; else U=(oldUint32>>9)/2^23 and returns q>=U, then updates xorshift state.
details.solverConvention: Keep actual float32 constants/branch order; document independent-draw abstraction and numerical precision separately from client replay.

claims.summary: 当前随机helper使用有限整数/float格点与有状态PRNG，精确模型必须公开所用抽样约定。
